packageRules.description: Crates reachable only through another crate's dependencies — rustls via ureq, aws-lc-sys via aws-config — appear in no Cargo.toml, so no range bump ever refreshes them and they go stale indefinitely. Lock file maintenance is the only mechanism that re-resolves them. It also covers crates/rw-napi/Cargo.lock, which is a separate workspace whose AWS stack arrives entirely through path dependencies
npm lock maintenance stays off: direct dependencies are already kept current by rangeStrategy bump below, and refreshing the viewer's transitive tree is a separate decision
Bump so npm updates edit package.json and package-lock.json together — avoids lockfile-mirror drift in npm workspaces (see renovatebot/renovate#28797)
The engines.node constraint is a deliberate minimum (set to match a tooling requirement), not something to auto-bump to the latest release
